LESSON: ADHESIVES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: General
Strand: Materials 2.2 Timber conversion and seasoning (14 lessons) By the end of the sub
Topic 2.3: Adhesives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Adhesives, part of Materials 2.2 Timber conversion and seasoning (14 lessons) By the end of the sub in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 General.

Key inquiry question: Why are wood adhesives important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify types of adhesives used for bonding materials,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Adhesives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. describe the characteristics of adhesives used in woodwork,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Adhesives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. use adhesives to bond materials in woodwork.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Adhesives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the importance and use of wood adhesives. • in groups or in pairs, learners are guided to discuss types of adhesives used in bonding materials, • in groups or in pairs, learners with low vision are guided to use visual aids to view types of adhesives used in bonding materials, while learners with blindness are guided to explore and identify types of adhesives through tactile, verbal descriptions and multi-sensory methods, Why are wood adhesives important? 19 caution: use non-toxic adhesives to ensure safety, • in groups or in pairs, learners are guided to classify adhesives used in woodwork, • in groups or in pairs, learners with low vision are guided to use digital devices with assistive technology to search online the characteristics of adhesives used in woodwork; internal and external use, • in groups or in pairs, learners with low vision are guided to watch a video clip on how adhesives are used in woodwork while learners with blindness are guided to listen to an audio description of how adhesives are used in woodwork, with detailed verbal descriptions of each step or audio-visual clips, • in groups or pairs, learners with low vision are guided to prepare and apply adhesives on a surface ready for bonding, while learners with blindness are guided to use 20 safe, tactile markers, hands-on demonstrations and guided experience that ensures full participation and understanding of the process, • in groups or pairs, learners are guided to discuss safety precautions related to use and disposal of adhesives used in woodwork, • in groups or in pairs, learners with low vision are guided to visit a nearby workshop to observe the use of adhesives in woodwork while learners with blindness are guided to manipulate and explore tools and materials involved in adhesive application such as brushes, glue bottles, wooden pieces with supervision as they listen to verbal descriptions. 21

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Adhesives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Adhesives together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: learner develops speaking, listening and teamwork skills when discussing types of

adhesives used in bonding materials

• Learning to learn: learner reflects on own work when visiting nearby workshop to observe and listen to uses of adhesives

used in Woodwork.

• Digital literacy: learner develops digital skills when interacting and manipulating digital devices to search online the

characteristics of adhesives used in Woodwork.

Values:
• Responsibility: learner takes care of adhesives when applying on a surface to avoid wastage.

• Unity: learner work together in groups to discuss types of adhesives used in bonding materials and classification of

adhesives.

• Respect: learner appreciates diverse opinions of others as they discuss safety precautions related to use and disposal of

adhesives.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Drug and substance abuse: learner prepares and applies adhesives on a surface.

• Environmental conservation: learner manage the use and disposal of adhesive wastes

Suggested Resources: adhesives, timber, digital devices, audio-visual devices, internet, magnifiers, tactile markers

Key Concepts/Skills:

Identifying types of adhesives used for bonding materials in woodwork,

Using adhesives to bond materials in woodwork.
